name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair Davies' journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for model cars and an innate ability to perfectly replicate their paint schemes. He honed his skills through apprenticeships at local body shops, quickly mastering the art of color matching, paint application, and detailing. Alistair's meticulous approach and keen eye for aesthetics caught the attention of Toyota Gazoo Racing BR, where he now plays a pivotal role in ensuring the team's cars look as fast as they perform.

He views his role as more than just applying paint; it's about contributing to the overall visual identity and performance of the team. He is constantly experimenting with new techniques and materials to improve the durability and aerodynamics of the paint finishes. He believes that a perfect paint job can subtly enhance the car's performance, giving the team a competitive edge. Alistair is ambitious, always striving to innovate and push the boundaries of what's possible in motorsport aesthetics, aiming for perfection in every coat.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight side part
physical.description: Alistair is of average height, with a focused and intense gaze.

quirks: Always wears pristine white overalls, even when handling the messiest paints.
Meticulously organizes his workspace, with every tool in its designated place.
Has an encyclopedic knowledge of car paint codes and their historical significance.
